title: Parliament ratifies emergency and governor's rule in KP; TTAP calls off talks
detail: A joint sitting of Parliament approved the emergency (Article 232) and governor's rule (Article 234) in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa for two months, after both houses endorsed them separately the day before. The emergency resolution reportedly passed 240-46. The opposition alliance TTAP called off negotiations with the government, calling the measures unconstitutional.
